Gideon's corrected figure for Vantorre Group in the July thread is 280 seats. He first posted 300, then corrected it to 280 at 09:19 on July 1, saying it is the active seat count on the production roster as of that day.

This is an operational fact (seat count), so it's fine to use in the QBR deck. He also mentioned the figure came from a combined staging tab that included sandbox logins, so if the deck needs a current number, it's worth confirming with Gideon, since the thread is from July.
